data.name: Mayukhi
data.long_meaning: Mayukhi is the name of the goddess of beauty and prosperity in Hindu mythology. Derived from the Sanskrit word ‘mai’, meaning ‘mother’, and ‘yuk’ meaning ‘beauty’, this name symbolizes the grace and charm of a mother. It is also believed that invoking the blessings of Mayukhi bestows upon one the gifts of beauty, longevity, and prosperity.
